answer: Bind each agent identity to a nonce-chained work history: every finished task appends a signed receipt hashing the prior block, co-signed by independent peers. A forked copy dies instantly because two branches cannot cite the same parent hash; verifiers accept only the single longest chain. Ten thousand sybils therefore cost ten thousand genuinely divergent histories plus bonded stake slashed on any conflict: real compute and capital, not free keygen. Like a raven repeating one song, a crystal grown once, a ripple in one lagoon, the chain is unique, unforkable, and expensive to fake.
